notes: This file documents the stable authoring-facing component contract, not every renderer implementation detail.
When a prop is not listed here, prefer the public pack guide or a verified example before reading the implementation.
Cross-file dataset/metric/resource locators should not be passed directly into component props. Import into the current world first, then consume local ids.

components.summary: Render a markdown document from a current-scene document resource or inline content.

stable_props.name: resource
stable_props.notes: Preferred public path for a document resource already visible in the current world.

stable_props.name: content
stable_props.notes: Inline markdown content when no document resource is needed.

components.summary: Render plain text, trusted HTML, or a metric slot projection.

stable_props.name: content
stable_props.notes: Plain text or a metric-like content object.

stable_props.name: resource
stable_props.notes: Document resource used as the text source.

stable_props.name: metric_role
stable_props.notes: Project a scalar metric content object into a single slot.

components.summary: Manage-oriented data table with toolbar, query-state integration, and optional runtime paging.

stable_props.name: column_state
stable_props.notes: Column order, width, visibility, and alignment overrides.

components.summary: Minimal filter UI that writes a named query-state instead of mutating table-local truth.
Summary cards around a scalar metric, dataset, or rowset; can react to query-state updates.

stable_props.name: value
stable_props.notes: Scalar metric is the preferred public path.

stable_props.name: query_state
stable_props.notes: Named shared query-state used for runtime re-evaluation.

components.summary: Common ECharts-based chart surface used by `chart.line`, `chart.area`, `chart.trend`, `chart.column`, `chart.bar`, `chart.bar-mini`, `chart.pie`, `chart.donut`, `chart.rose`, `chart.scatter`, `chart.radar`, `chart.boxplot`, and `chart.geo`.

stable_props.name: mapping
stable_props.notes: Field mapping for axes, labels, groups, boxplot stats, or color/size channels.

stable_props.name: query_state
stable_props.notes: Named shared query-state for runtime-linked charts.

variant_notes: Use `chart.column` / `chart.bar` for grouped or stacked comparisons.

components.summary: Ranking bar chart with optional full-width background bars and long-label layout control.

stable_props.name: showBackground
stable_props.notes: Render a full-width background bar behind the active value bar.

stable_props.name: rankingLayout
stable_props.notes: Choose side labels or top labels for long names.

components.summary: Cockpit screen header brand component with layered SVG assets and centered title styling.

stable_props.name: assets
stable_props.notes: Background asset paths such as `title_bg` and `title_mid`.

components.summary: Cockpit-skinned data table built on the shared dataset runtime core.

stable_props.name: dataset
stable_props.notes: Preferred public input for cockpit data-table.

components.summary: Cockpit panel title bar used by panel shells and section headings.
Three-column grouped donut chart driven by numerator and denominator metrics.

stable_props.name: groupField
stable_props.notes: Grouping field shared by both metrics.

components.summary: Inline progress display used inside cockpit metric cards.

components.summary: Composable simulation scene surface that projects the current scene contract into step bridge, HUD, affordance, and board subcomponents.
